title: SnailSploit/Claude-Red: offensive-security skills for authorised testing
friendlyTitle: Claude-Red collects AI skills for approved security testing
summary: Claude-Red is a library of structured Claude skill files covering offensive-security methods across web, network, binary and endpoint attack surfaces. The repository has about 5,700 stars and ranked near the top of today’s AI-related Python trends.
friendlySummary: This project gives Claude detailed guides for many offensive-security tasks. It is popular on GitHub and contains powerful material.
whyItMatters: Security professionals can use the collection as reference material for controlled red-team work and to examine how detailed skills steer an agent. Because the content includes exploit and evasion methods, it belongs only in explicitly authorised, isolated environments with human oversight.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Trained security teams can study it in a safe test environment. Do not use it on systems unless you have clear permission.
